title: Working Capital Cycle Optimizer & CCC Stress Lab
description: Models the Cash Conversion Cycle (DSO, DIO, DPO) under baseline and stress scenarios. Ranks permutations by cash release, projects 30-day cash gap, and outputs a CFO-ready AP2 treasury mandate.

ar.description: Accounts Receivable params: dso_target, revenue_annual, ar_balance

ap.description: Accounts Payable params: dpo_target, cogs_annual, ap_balance

scenario.description: Stress scenario: dso_delta, dpo_delta, overdraft_threshold, seed

mcp_tool_definition.name: optimise_working_capital
mcp_tool_definition.description: Calculate CCC, stress-test DSO/DIO/DPO scenarios, rank permutations by cash release, and project 30-day cash gap. Returns baseline vs optimised CCC and a full AP2 treasury mandate. Use when an agent needs to quantify working capital improvement opportunities.
